recent.text: Warriors have scored 85, 94 and 94 points in three straight road blowout losses since the Steph Curry injury. First time they’ve scored below 95 in three straight since March of 2013.
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: Final: Mavericks 116, Warriors 94 Warriors have lost 4 straight. Blown out by 38, 21, and 22. Totally unrecognizable without Steph Curry. Defense has fallen apart, too, especially in transition. Will Richard showed up. Cooper Flagg is different. Warriors at MEM tomorrow night.
recent.author: Danny Emerman

recent.text: Yaxel Lendeborg said the last time his scoring was so needed for a team was his second year at UAB: “I kind of threw that out of my mind. I didn’t think I’d ever be in that position again.” Said he is becoming more comfortable with idea he can be lead NBA creator https://t.co/GVqtl2LkJz
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: The Warriors have ruled reserve guard Brandon Williams out of the final two games of their current road trip but indicate another evaluation will come Saturday. He’s back on the court and return appears imminent. Warriors particularly need his offense without Steph Curry.
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: Per Warriors: Brandon Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated again on Saturday, knocking him out from at least tonight and tomorrow’s contests. Williams has missed the last three games with the hamstring strain. GSW really misses his on-ball playmaking.
recent.author: Danny Emerman

recent.text: Draymond Green and Al Horford both questionable for the Warriors tomorrow night in Dallas (along with all the team's other injury absences). It's the front side of a back-to-back. Warriors close road trip in Memphis on Thursday. Green/Horford will presumably sit one side.
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: Steph Curry is on a race against time. Sat down with him recently to discuss his “basketball mortality.” He said the contract he signed this summer could be his last: “I'm not afraid to say it. But maybe I'll surprise myself and want to keep going." https://t.co/g9Axw1w9id

recent.text: Draymond Green on the shift he feels is needed in regard to Yaxel Lendeborg “Depend on him, but lower the expectation. It’s unfair to make him to step into Steph’s role 13 games into his career. Right now we’re putting too much pressure on him and it’s tough to deal with.” https://t.co/hZhWj3jM1U
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: Yaxel Lendeborg had 28 points and 8 rebounds tonight in New Orleans, but struggled through much of second straight Warriors blowout loss. Four turnovers, -30, slumped over on bench with towel over head in fourth quarter. Then had extended talk with Draymond Green. https://t.co/cB3ZcPVzXo
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: The Pelicans lost by 30+ three straight games over the past week. They lead the Warriors 35-11 after the first quarter in New Orleans tonight. Even without Steph Curry, very bad process from GSW. 6 turnovers, 5 2-point tries. Steve Kerr burned 3 timeouts trying to regroup.
recent.author: Danny Emerman
